meta.title: Messaging profitability model: input assumptions
meta.disclaimer: For demonstration. Market prices and fees are from public rate cards; customers are illustrative archetypes with estimated volumes. Not affiliated with any company. Not based on any company's real figures.

customers.name: US ride-hailing app
customers.volume_note: Estimated: ≈30M monthly active riders × 4 messages each (sign-in codes, trip updates) × 50% routed to us.

assumptions.label: Base EUR/USD exchange rate (2025 average)
assumptions.note: Average of the ECB euro reference rates for 2025, as published by the Bank of Finland (USD 1.1300 per euro).

assumptions.label: Target blended gross margin, lower bound
assumptions.note: Range chosen from listed peers' reported 2024 gross margins: LINK Mobility about 22% (gross profit NOK 1,528m on revenue of about NOK 6.99bn; Q4 2024 reported 23.6%, https://www.linkmobility.com/news/q4-interim-report-2024) and Sinch 34% (https://www.group.sinch.com/media/press-releases-and-news/2025/year-end-report-january-december-2024/), which includes higher-margin software. A messaging-heavy business sits in the low-to-mid 20s.

assumptions.label: Target blended gross margin, upper bound
assumptions.note: See target_margin_min.

assumptions.label: Volume discount on our own fee, tier 0 (from 0 messages per month)

assumptions.note: No public figure: CPaaS list pages only mention committed-use discounts without amounts. Tiers chosen so that large enterprise contracts are priced well below list, as is common in tenders.
